title: Nine Pages and One Stamp
subtitle: 申请与用途 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 申请与用途（社会服务与人际沟通·教育与申请）
meta: 主题语境：申请与用途（社会服务与人际沟通·教育与申请）　|　核心词汇：application　|　正文 334 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 application 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1988 my sister filled in ① an application for a place she had never seen, nine pages of it, and posted it on the last day. The ② application, meaning the form and not the hope, was returned twice for the same reason; an application, my mother said, is a letter you have to fill in with somebody else's words. She said the hard part was not the writing but the handwriting.

Every ③ application that year asked the same question at the bottom, and my sister answered it nine different ways before she sent one. The ④ application form, my father said, is the only writing in the world that tells you what to think and how long to take; an application, he said, is a test you are allowed to fail quietly.

My uncle, who mended machines, said the ⑤ application of a rule was the only kind of writing he trusted, and my mother said he had got the word wrong. The ⑥ practical application, meaning the use and not the paper, was the only part my father cared about; an application, he said, is a promise you have not been asked to keep. My sister said that was the only true thing anybody said about it that year.

The ⑦ application, meaning the idea and not either the paper or the use, is nine parts patience and one part luck, my mother said; an application, she said, is the only thing you send away and never get back. There was an ⑧ application fee of nine pounds, which my father said was the honest part of the whole business.

By March the ⑨ application had gone in twice and been read once, and the answer came in nine days. An ⑩ application, my father said in 1991, is the only kind of writing in which the reader decides who you are and you are not in the room; every application, he said, is a conversation with one side missing. He said the missing side is always the louder one.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 申请；申请书（一次具体的申请）
B. n. 申请表；申请书（指那份文件本身）
C. n. 运用；实施（规则、方法的执行）
D. 固定搭配：an application form 申请表
F. n. 申请（抽象概念；这件事）
G. 固定搭配：an application fee 申请费
H. n. 申请（泛指这类文书）

items.q: The application, meaning the form and not the hope
the application had gone in twice
An application, my father said in 1991

answers.why: application 意为“一次具体的申请”，1988 年姐姐为一个她从没见过的地方填了九页申请表。
application 指“那份文件本身”，申请表而不是那份希望，因为同一个原因被退回来两次。
application 泛指“申请这类文书”，那一年每一份申请都在底部问了同一个问题。
application form 意为“申请表”，父亲说这是世上唯一一种告诉你该想什么、想多久的文字。
application 意为“运用、实施”，叔叔说规则的运用是他唯一信得过的那种文字，母亲说他用错了词。
application 意为“应用、用途”，实际应用指的是用处而不是那张纸，那是父亲唯一在乎的部分。
application 为抽象概念，指“申请这件事”，既不是纸也不是用途，是九分耐心加一分运气。
application fee 意为“申请费”，九镑申请费，父亲说那是整件事里最诚实的部分。
application 意为“一次具体的申请”，到三月这份申请寄进去两次，被读过一次。
application 泛指“申请这类文书”，父亲说这是唯一一种由读的人决定你是谁、而你不在场的文字。
